# AIABASD — African International Alliance for Business & Sustainable Development

> AIABASD (African International Alliance for Business & Sustainable Development; Arabic: التحالف الدولي الأفريقي للأعمال والتنمية المستدامة) is an international platform for economic, investment, and development cooperation. It builds strategic partnerships between Africa, the Arab world, and international markets, and converts economic opportunities and development projects into bankable, executable initiatives — acting as the strategic link between opportunity, capital, technology, market, and execution. Programs are structured as PPP, BOT, EPC+F, joint ventures, and direct investment across sectors including infrastructure, renewable energy, industry, agriculture and food security, health, digital infrastructure and AI, and the circular economy, governed by ESIA/ESMS safeguards, KYC/AML screening, independent engineers and auditors, and success fees tied to verified milestones. The platform operates across eleven sovereign corridors in Africa and the Arab world — including Ghana, Sierra Leone, The Gambia, Côte d'Ivoire, Burkina Faso, Angola, Sudan, Egypt, Jordan, Syria, and Saudi Arabia — with strategic cooperation tracks with China, East Asia, and Europe. The platform is strictly non-custodial: no funds, deposits, capital transactions, or banking balances are handled directly through this platform. All financial engagements and sovereign agreements operate through authorized commercial banks, multilateral development entities, and licensed institutional stakeholders.

## Locales

- [English Platform](https://aiabasd.org/): Primary English language interface.
- [Arabic Platform (المنصة العربية)](https://aiabasd.org/ar/): Arabic language interface with full Right-to-Left (RTL) localization.
- [French Platform (Plateforme Française)](https://aiabasd.org/fr/): French language interface for Francophone corridors.

## Core Platform

- [/knowledge](https://aiabasd.org/knowledge): Trilingual cooperation-model guide based on the Alliance's published government and governance guidance.
- [/preparation](https://aiabasd.org/preparation): Personal project-preparation checklist with optional local saving and a downloadable working note; not a verified readiness assessment.

- [/companies](https://aiabasd.org/companies): Company directory with public profiles and explicit distinctions between a listing and documentary verification.
- [/introductions](https://aiabasd.org/introductions): Structured requests to meet a company or discuss a published project need. Connections require team review.

- [/](https://aiabasd.org/): Institutional overview, flagship programs, and the FAQ section (/#faq) answering the most common questions about coverage, models, governance, and partnership.
- [/projects](https://aiabasd.org/projects): Multi-sector directory of capital, reconstruction, and development projects across African and Arab corridors.
- [/pipeline](https://aiabasd.org/pipeline): Active and staged project pipeline categorized by development status, corridor, and readiness.
- [/visions](https://aiabasd.org/visions): Strategic reconstruction and sustainable development vision frameworks for post-conflict and emerging markets.
- [/services](https://aiabasd.org/services): Advisory, consortium assembly, project structuring, and technical coordination services for institutional partners.
- [/governments](https://aiabasd.org/governments): Government and public-institution partnership pathway — from mandate to execution under PPP/BOT/EPC+F structures with ESIA/ESMS, KYC/AML, and independent oversight.
- [/intelligence](https://aiabasd.org/intelligence): Economic intelligence, corridor assessments, and regulatory analysis for regional reconstruction and infrastructure.
- [/match](https://aiabasd.org/match): Institutional matching interface aligning project sponsors with qualified consortium partners and EPC contractors.
- [/opportunity-map](https://aiabasd.org/opportunity-map): Interactive geographic visualization of infrastructure projects and investment opportunities across corridors.

## Knowledge & Tools

- [/glossary](https://aiabasd.org/glossary): Trilingual glossary of 40 PPP/infrastructure-finance terms with plain-language definitions (educational reference).
- [/templates](https://aiabasd.org/templates): Downloadable preparation templates — letter of intent and structured project brief — in EN/AR/FR (plain text, device-side download only).

## Market Pages

- [/opportunities/{iso}/{sector}](https://aiabasd.org/opportunities/sy/energy): 88 sector-by-country market pages (11 corridors x 8 sectors) listing the published projects and partnership paths for each combination, in EN/AR/FR. Example: [/opportunities/sy/energy](https://aiabasd.org/opportunities/sy/energy).

## Governance & Trust

- [/trust](https://aiabasd.org/trust): Centralized trust and verification repository detailing institutional oversight, data privacy practices, and contact directory.
- [/governance/esia-esms](https://aiabasd.org/governance/esia-esms): Environmental and Social Impact Assessment (ESIA) and Environmental and Social Management System (ESMS) compliance protocols.
- [/governance/kyc-aml](https://aiabasd.org/governance/kyc-aml): Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) standards aligned with international banking norms.
- [/governance/independent-oversight](https://aiabasd.org/governance/independent-oversight): Multi-tiered oversight architecture featuring independent technical, environmental, and financial verification.
- [/governance/contracts](https://aiabasd.org/governance/contracts): Standardized legal and contractual frameworks safeguarding transparency, stakeholder rights, and cross-border execution.

## Regional Programs

- [/programs/hama-rehabilitation](https://aiabasd.org/programs/hama-rehabilitation): Comprehensive municipal infrastructure and housing rehabilitation initiative in Hama, Syria.
- [/programs/al-arish-hub](https://aiabasd.org/programs/al-arish-hub): Strategic logistics, humanitarian transshipment, and supply chain corridor hub in Al-Arish, Egypt.
- [/programs/green-energy](https://aiabasd.org/programs/green-energy): Renewable energy transition initiatives deploying utility-scale solar and distributed clean grids.
- [/programs/digital-africa](https://aiabasd.org/programs/digital-africa): Digital transformation program supporting telecommunications, data infrastructure, and digital governance in Africa.
- [/programs/integrated-cities](https://aiabasd.org/programs/integrated-cities): Master-planned sustainable urban communities integrating housing, clean energy, and municipal services.
- [/programs/debris-recycling](https://aiabasd.org/programs/debris-recycling): Industrial circular economy program processing conflict rubble into certified construction aggregates.
- [/programs/food-security](https://aiabasd.org/programs/food-security): Modern agricultural infrastructure, cold-chain logistics, and solar irrigation systems to enhance food resilience.
- [/hama-project](https://aiabasd.org/hama-project): Integrated municipal reconstruction master plan for the historical city of Hama, Syria.

## Country Corridors

- [/corridors/sy](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/sy): Syria Corridor — Infrastructure reconstruction, urban housing, renewable energy, and industrial revitalization.
- [/corridors/sd](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/sd): Sudan Corridor — Post-conflict reconstruction vision, productive housing, and agricultural corridor rehabilitation.
- [/corridors/jo](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/jo): Jordan Corridor — Regional logistics connectivity, water infrastructure, and energy transit networks.
- [/corridors/eg](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/eg): Egypt Corridor — Cross-border logistics, industrial integration, and maritime transit hubs.
- [/corridors/sa](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/sa): Saudi Arabia Corridor — GCC capital alignment, industrial manufacturing hubs, and energy transition partnerships.
- [/corridors/gh](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/gh): Ghana Corridor — West African trade infrastructure, agro-processing, and renewable power.
- [/corridors/ci](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/ci): Côte d'Ivoire Corridor — Transport corridors, agricultural value addition, and commercial logistics.
- [/corridors/ao](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/ao): Angola Corridor — Mineral logistics, infrastructure development, and industrial diversification.
- [/corridors/bf](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/bf): Burkina Faso Corridor — Resilient infrastructure, decentralized solar energy, and community development.
- [/corridors/gm](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/gm): The Gambia Corridor — Maritime logistics, coastal infrastructure, and digital connectivity.
- [/corridors/sl](https://aiabasd.org/corridors/sl): Sierra Leone Corridor — Sustainable resource management, port logistics, and power grid expansion.

## Key Public Projects

- [/projects/hama-solar-200mw](https://aiabasd.org/projects/hama-solar-200mw): 200MW photovoltaic solar power plant in Hama province, Syria.
- [/projects/sudan-productive-housing](https://aiabasd.org/projects/sudan-productive-housing): Reconstruction of productive housing communities with integrated agricultural plots and solar microgrids in Sudan.
- [/projects/sudan-reconstruction-vision](https://aiabasd.org/projects/sudan-reconstruction-vision): National reconstruction blueprint across urban recovery, critical infrastructure, and supply corridor rehabilitation in Sudan.
- [/projects/hama-debris-recycling](https://aiabasd.org/projects/hama-debris-recycling): Concrete and masonry rubble recycling facility converting urban debris into certified aggregates for reconstruction in Hama, Syria.
- [/projects/smart-meters-syria](https://aiabasd.org/projects/smart-meters-syria): Deployment of digital electricity metering infrastructure and grid monitoring across municipal networks in Syria.
- [/projects/dummar-housing](https://aiabasd.org/projects/dummar-housing): Sustainable residential complex with integrated public services, energy-efficient building systems, and community amenities in Dummar, Syria.
- [/projects/hama-housing](https://aiabasd.org/projects/hama-housing): Multi-phase residential reconstruction program providing durable housing and municipal infrastructure in Hama, Syria.
- [/projects/schools-health-rehabilitation](https://aiabasd.org/projects/schools-health-rehabilitation): Reconstruction and structural modernization of public schools and primary healthcare clinics in conflict-affected communities in Syria.
- [/projects/hasiya-industrial-zone](https://aiabasd.org/projects/hasiya-industrial-zone): Industrial park infrastructure rehabilitation, reliable power feeds, and logistics hubs in Hasiya, Syria.
- [/projects/hama-agriculture-water](https://aiabasd.org/projects/hama-agriculture-water): Solar-powered irrigation networks, water management infrastructure, and agricultural logistics support in Hama rural areas.
- [/projects/cci-investment-portfolio](https://aiabasd.org/projects/cci-investment-portfolio): Strategic investment framework connecting GCC institutional capital with productive infrastructure assets across Africa and the Arab region.
- [/projects/ghana-cooperation-program](https://aiabasd.org/projects/ghana-cooperation-program): Bilateral development and trade infrastructure initiatives supporting agro-processing, energy, and digital connectivity in Ghana.
- [/projects/angola-vision](https://aiabasd.org/projects/angola-vision): Multi-sector investment and development program focused on agriculture, logistics corridors, and industrial diversification in Angola.
- [/projects/china-arab-africa-platform](https://aiabasd.org/projects/china-arab-africa-platform): Trilateral industrial cooperation and trade corridor connecting Chinese industrial technology, Arab financing, and African development projects.
- [/projects/china-saudi-africa-gateway](https://aiabasd.org/projects/china-saudi-africa-gateway): Strategic trade, logistics, and industrial value chain gateway linking Saudi industrial corridors with African markets and Asian manufacturing.
- [/projects/cross-border-trade-platform](https://aiabasd.org/projects/cross-border-trade-platform): Digital trade facilitation, customs compliance, and logistics tracking for intra-regional commerce across Arab and African states.
- [/projects/advanced-technology-cooperation](https://aiabasd.org/projects/advanced-technology-cooperation): Technology transfer framework and digital infrastructure development program for sustainable industrial modernization.

## Member Access

- [/access](https://aiabasd.org/access): Member sign-in (one-time email link). Project rooms, documents, and tasks are private to invited collaboration teams and are not publicly indexed.

## Legal & Policies

- [/privacy](https://aiabasd.org/privacy): Data privacy policy, zero third-party tracking disclosure, and data subject rights.
- [/terms](https://aiabasd.org/terms): Terms of platform usage, non-commercial institutional coordination framework, and legal disclaimers.
